title: Enma LSP v1.0 — Phases 4 through 10 (solo ralph completion)
description: Finish the Enma Language Server build started by the team-orchestration phase. Phases 0-3 are on disk and green; this PRD covers analyzer completion through v1.0.0 distribution. Plan: D:/Projects/enma-lsp/.omc/plans/enma-lsp-fullstack.md (canonical specification). Non-paraphrasable specs §A1-§A13 must be implemented exactly.

stories.title: Phase 4 — Wire all 11 Enma-specific analyzer subsystems
stories.description: Complete the analyzer's Enma-specific files. Most exist as scaffolding from the team session (analyzer.ts 7kB skeleton, hoist.ts 22kB, autoResolution.ts present). Need to flesh out: mro.ts (§A3 C3 linearization), pointerRules.ts (AC-7), permissionGate.ts (AC-9), annotationCheck.ts (with [[shadow]]), intrinsics.ts, matchStatement.ts (exhaustiveness), deferStatement.ts, templateInstantiation.ts (4-component cache key with mro-fingerprint), fStringExpr.ts (consume §A2 boundary tokens). All subsystems unit-tested.
acceptanceCriteria: server/src/compiler_analyzer/mro.ts exists and exports a C3-linearization function for SymbolType.baseList; diamond-equal-rank methods raise an ambiguous-method-resolution diagnostic

server/src/compiler_analyzer/pointerRules.ts exists; emits 'use \'.\' for value access' on `->` over non-pointer and 'use \'->\' for pointer access' on `.` over pointer; uses errorForce() so it stays Error under R21 rollback
server/src/compiler_analyzer/permissionGate.ts exists; [[dll(...)]] emits diagnostic when enma.permissions.ffi=false; uses errorForce() so it stays Error under R21

server/src/compiler_analyzer/annotationCheck.ts exists; registers known annotations including [[shadow]]; type-checks args (e.g. [[align(N)]] requires int; [[dll(\"name\")]] requires string literal); annotation-arg type errors use errorForce()
server/src/compiler_analyzer/intrinsics.ts exists; types __va_count (no parens), __va_arg(i), __asm_rdtsc(), __asm_pause(), __asm_mfence(), __asm_nop()
server/src/compiler_analyzer/matchStatement.ts exists; warns when non-_ match doesn't cover all enum values
server/src/compiler_analyzer/deferStatement.ts exists; flags use of out-of-scope locals in defer body

server/src/compiler_analyzer/templateInstantiation.ts exists; cache key tuple is (template-symbol, type-args, instantiating-scope-uri, mro-fingerprint) — verifiable via grep 'mro-fingerprint' in the file
server/src/compiler_analyzer/fStringExpr.ts exists; analyzes NodeExprFString.parts; resolves converter overloads on expression parts
Each subsystem has a corresponding test file under server/test/unit/analyzer/<subsystem>.test.ts with at least 3 test cases each
TypeScript compile clean (npx tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json) — 0 errors
Test suite passes (npx mocha at server/) with no regressions

stories.title: Phase 4 closure — Tighten showcase.em to ≤30 hoist-time errors + wire R21 rollback exemption list
stories.description: Close out Phase 4 by reducing showcase.em hoist-time errors from ~150 to ≤30 (the wk3 decay target per the analyzer's documented decay path: ≤100 wk2 → ≤30 wk3 → ≤5 wk4 → 0 wk5). Wire R21 severity-rollback so AC-7/9/18/[[align/dll]] stay Error regardless of the flag.
acceptanceCriteria: samples/showcase.em produces ≤30 hoist-time errors when run through tokenize → preprocess → parse → hoist (no inspector wrapping yet — that's US-003)

Test suite passes with no regressions

stories.title: Phase 5 — Inspector + analysis queue + §A8 memory budget
stories.description: Build server/src/inspector/{inspector.ts, analysisResolver.ts, analysisQueue.ts}. Composes the pipeline tokenize → preprocess → parse → hoist → analyze per URI. Delayed-task queue with priority levels. §A4 cycle detection at workspace level (consumes preprocessor's includePathTokens). §A8 per-record memory budget <5MB/kLoC + LRU enma.indexCache.maxClosedFiles=300.
acceptanceCriteria: server/src/inspector/inspector.ts exists; exports InspectRecord {content, uri, diagnosticsInParser, diagnosticsInAnalyzer, rawTokens, preprocessedOutput, ast, isAnalyzerPending, analyzerScope}; exports inspectFile(uri, content)
server/src/inspector/analysisResolver.ts exists; delayed-task queue with priority levels (open file = high, dependent = medium, background = low); exports request(record), flush(uri?)
server/src/inspector/analysisQueue.ts exists; FIFO with priority bands
Setting enma.indexCache.maxClosedFiles defaults to 300; LRU evicts analyzerScope on closed-file records when count exceeds cap; tokens+AST retained
Inspector wrapping resolves #include workspace-wide; samples/showcase.em now produces 0 hoist-time errors when fed through inspector.inspectFile (full pipeline)
Test inspector.test.ts: open A imports B, edit B, A re-analyzes; close A, re-edit B, A still indexed
Test memory-budget.test.ts: 50-file fixture stress test, per-record <5MB/kLoC after GC
Test suite passes with no regressions

AC-21b [[shadow]] suppression. §A11 permissions hardening banner in client.
